correctness.rationale: Headline claim independently replayed end-to-end. (1) PG(2,3) construction: 13 points, 13 four-point lines recomputed; |PGL(3,3)|=5616 recomputed by enumerating all invertible 3x3 matrices over GF(3) and deduplicating point-permutations (verify.py V1, independently re-run in audit). (2) All C(13,8)=1287 eight-sets canonicalized under this group yield exactly 3 orbits with member counts 702/117/468 summing to 1287 (orbit-stabilizer with recomputed PGL-stabilizers 8/48/12), closing the ternary census because every ternary spanning simple rank-3 8-point matroid is a restriction of PG(2,3). Ordinary (2-point flat) counts replay as 4, 4, 7, so E_3=4 with two minimizer orbits. (3) Both minimizer coordinatizations verified: V_A and V_B each use 8 distinct projective points, collinearity flats have exactly 4 two-point lines, and canonical-form comparison proves V_A is isomorphic to PGL orbit 0 and V_B to PGL orbit 1 (explicit matching perms [2,5,6,4,7,3,0,1] and [0,7,1,2,4,3,5,6] replayed), while the two orbits are pairwise non-isomorphic with abstract Aut orders 8/48/12 (labeled class sizes 5040/840/3360). (4) Abstract cross-check re-ran: K8 clique-partition census gives 433039 leaves including the single-line, i.e. 433038 spanning families in 62 coarse signature groups, matching SCOPE026 total; group ordinary minimum is 4 on groups of sizes 1680 (Aut 24), 5040 (Aut 8), 840 (Aut 48); canonical comparison shows 5040==PGL0, 840==PGL1, 1680 distinct from all three PGL orbits. Exhaustive normalized GF(3) search on the 1680 rep (basis fixed to e1,e2,e3, all 10^5 completions, 30240 distinct-point cases checked in ~2s) finds no realization, certifying non-ternarity by search failure. verify.py run from output/artifacts ends ALL CHECKS PASS. Limitations are honestly stated (62 coarse groups vs 68 iso types; non-ternarity by search failure not excluded minor; no 68-type library or 7-point table) and do not touch the PGL-closed headline. Proof, not mere experiment: completeness comes from the group-action partition summing to C(13,8).

originality.rationale: Nearest sources checked substantively at abstract/theorem level and fetched live: Geelen-Kroeker arXiv:2212.03307 proves every complex-representable matroid of rank>=4^(k-1) has a rank-k flat with exactly k points (k=2 is Kelly) — a general asymptotic complex-regime bound with no finite n=8 ternary ordinary-line minimum, classification, or coordinatizations. Green-Tao arXiv:1208.4714 proves >=n/2 ordinary lines for large n plus extremals/orchard/cubic-curve structure — a large-n Euclidean regime with no ternary-matroid 8-point claim. Mayhew-Royle arXiv:math/0702316 provides a bare catalogue of matroids up to 9 elements (counts/lists) with no per-type GF(3)-membership decisions, coordinatizations, excluded-minor certificates, or ordinary-line minima. Internal precedent SCOPE026 gives the 68-type census with Tutte T(2,0) maximizer 58 vs 56, which neither states nor implies 2-point-line counts. No source states E_3=4 with two minimizer types (Aut 8/48), explicit 3x8 GF(3)-matrices, line partitions (4^1.3^6.2^4 and 3^8.2^4), orbit sizes 702/117/468, or the 3-to-2 ternary filtering of the abstract 4-line locus (Aut-24 non-ternary type). Claim is not a parameter substitution or mechanical implication (ternary does not imply complex-representable; n=8 is below Green-Tao large-n regime; Tutte values do not imply line counts).

value.rationale: Independently worth retrieving as a rigorously established exact invariant of a specific natural object. Object (ternary/GF(3)-representable rank-3 8-point stratum, Seymour excluded-minor class) and invariant (ordinary-line minimum with minimizer classification) were motivated before computation by the finite-field Sylvester-Gallai boundary (real Sylvester-Gallai, Kelly complex rank-3, Geelen-Kroeker complex rank-k), and n=8 is the first scope above the 7-point Fano/non-Fano threshold where binary (Fano has 0 ordinary lines), ternary, and complex behaviors diverge. The value E_3=4 with exactly two minimizers (Aut 8/48), third orbit 7 lines (Aut 12), orbit partition 702+117+468=1287, plus the separation fact that the abstract 4-line locus has a third non-ternary type (Aut 24, 1680 labeled members), was not known or mechanically implied. A future researcher in the Seymour/Rota or Sylvester-Gallai programs could reasonably need the precise minimum, minimizer identities, coordinatizations, and line partitions. Judged as the self-contained headline, not the unfinished surrounding survey: the admitted 68-type library/7-point table are honestly listed as NOT delivered but do not erase the exact headline. This is an exact datum with interpretation (finite separation witness), not an arbitrary slice or unexplained number.
